mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate is persistently below its long-run average, lower real interest rates incentivize equity investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero in low-rate periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in monthly employment (PAYEMS) coinciding with rising consumer demand (HOUST) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as labor market strength supports corporate earnings growth.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >2% in a month and HOUST rises by >3% in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative despite the described labor and demand signals (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly acceleration in industrial production (INDPRO) above trend suggests accelerating economic activity, which precedes positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative even when INDPRO is above trend for the period (rolling IC < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) unexpectedly spikes above 2%, investors anticipate tighter policy, causing a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 2.0 in a given month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite CPIAUCSL > 2.0 (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising unemployment rates (UNRATE) below 5% indicate a tightening labor market, which, when combined with falling inflation (CPIAUCSL), produces positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5% for two consecutive months and CPIAUCSL < 2% in the same period
regime_hint: labor market tightening with cooling inflation
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not positive despite the trigger (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in job openings (PAYEMS) below 7 million coinciding with a decline in manufacturing activity (RSAFS) signals labor market softening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS falls below 7 million and RSAFS decreases by >5% in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in both industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts proxy (HOUST) above trend suggests robust demand, producing positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
Note: Since only available proxies are GDPC1, HOUST, INDPRO, etc., the following uses available ones. Adjusted to use available proxies.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases by >4% and HOUST increases by >4% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not positive despite the signal (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% in a month, without a corresponding rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL), suggests strong labor market and policy easing, resulting in positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE drops below 4% in a month and CPIAUCSL remains below 2.5% in the same month
regime_hint: labor market strength with controlled inflation
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not positive despite the UNRATE/CPIAUCSL pattern (p > 0.05).
